title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Permutation and Combination
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: The number of ways of distributing 20 identical balloons among 4 children such that each child gets some balloons but no child gets an odd number of balloons, is
questions.explain: Since each child must get an even number of balloons and at least 2 balloons (some balloons means > 0), let the balloons received by children be $2a, 2b, 2c, 2d$ where $a, b, c, d \ge 1$. Then $2a + 2b + 2c + 2d = 20 \Rightarrow a + b + c + d = 10$. The number of positive integer solutions to this equation is $\binom{10-1}{4-1} = \binom{9}{3} = \frac{9 \times 8 \times 7}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 84$.
